video.title: The Most Underrated Side Hustle You Can Start With $0

summary: Chris Koerner interviews Braden, a former territory sales manager from central Arkansas who started an estate sale company in 2017 with almost no capital. He explains the 35% commission model, three-day markdowns, lead sources (EstateSales.net, overflow from established companies, realtor meetings) and a warehouse model that combined up to 30 small estates into $20-30k weekend sales, peaking at $30-40k gross per month. The estate sale business became a funnel for off-market real estate: about 60 houses since 2018 via wholesaling, flips and mid-term rentals on Furnish Finder. Key takeaway: a low-capital, unsexy service that gives first access to distressed sellers can feed a much more profitable business.

speakers.name: Braden
speakers.description: Estate sale company co-founder and real estate investor in central Arkansas; author of flippingcouches.com

ideas.name: Estate sale company
ideas.one_liner: Contract with families to price and sell the entire contents of a house over a 2-3 day on-site sale for a 35% commission, starting with almost no capital.
ideas.business_model: commission on gross sales (typically 35%, up to 45-50% for small homes) with optional minimum guarantee; marketing fees passed to client
ideas.customer: Heirs of the deceased, divorcing couples, people in debt/foreclosure, downsizers (the 'four Ds'), often referred by realtors, elder-law attorneys and investors
ideas.problem: Families must empty a house fast so it can be sold
ideas.offer: Full-service on-site sale: price every item, market the sale, staff it, collect payments, send leftover to auction, pay client ~2 weeks later

pricing.notes: Offers like 39% instead of 40% ('nine numbers'). Day 1 full price, day 2 20-25% off, day 3 50% off.

acquisition_channels.details: Listed as a company on EstateSales.net; sales posted there and emailed weekly to buyers; posting fee $100-200.

quote.text: The nationwide number one resource and the one that most if not all estate sale companies use is estates salesales.net
quote.speaker: Braden

acquisition_channels.details: Worked for and got overflow/small leads from established estate sale companies.

quote.text: asked them if they would send us small leads that they didn't have time to fool with or didn't want to. And they did
quote.speaker: Braden

acquisition_channels.details: Brought breakfast/donuts to real estate brokerage meetings for a 10-minute pitch.

quote.text: can I bring you guys breakfast, coffee, donuts, etc. at your next broker meeting and just tell you tell your staff about
quote.speaker: Braden

acquisition_channels.details: Real estate investors/flippers, elder-law attorneys and realtors refer clients.
Facebook Marketplace posts and Facebook ads using keywords estate sales, estate liquidation, yard sales, garage sales.

ideas.delivery: Owner walks the house, estimates gross room by room, prices every item with a price gun or painter's tape, family/staff run cashier, floor and loading roles; leftovers go to auction (which takes 35%).
unit_economics_claims: First sale grossed $5-6k with no cost
$10k gross sale nets about $2.5-3k after staff
First year ~$5k/month gross, year 2 $10k, year 3 $20-30k, peak $30-40k/month
Part-timer can make an extra $1-4k a month on weekends
ideas.startup_cost: Almost nothing: tape, price gun, phone/POS, borrowed tables (~$50 or $2 rental each)
ideas.time_to_first_revenue: First week; first sale within two to three weeks

acquisition.how: Inbound via listing sites and referrals automates partly; in-person relationship building with realtors caps it.

delivery.how: Physical pricing, staffing and selling on site.

billing.how: POS and reconciliation software can automate.

uk_applicability.notes: UK equivalent is 'house clearance' and on-site 'estate sales' are culturally rare; selling firearms requires licensing under UK firearms law; removing waste needs an Environment Agency waste carrier licence; probate timelines differ.

risks: Firearms and drugs found in houses

quotes.text: You could literally start this with no money and then be cash flow positive your first week
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Multi-estate warehouse sales
ideas.one_liner: Aggregate 10-30 small estates that are too small for their own sale into a periodic warehouse sale with lot-numbered pricing.
ideas.business_model: commission on each estate's lot plus buyouts
ideas.customer: Small estates other companies turn down; clients with HOA or timing limits
ideas.problem: Small estates ($1-2k of items) are unprofitable as individual sales
ideas.offer: Pickup or drop-off of items to a warehouse, combined weekend sale with cross-pollinated buyers; leftovers from house sales re-sold here at lower prices

pricing.notes: Clients wait longer to be paid but houses empty faster.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook/social ads as a flyer with address/date, no specific items.
Leads that other estate sale companies don't want.

ideas.delivery: Mon-Thu pricing lots, each estate tagged with a lot number; cash register supports up to 50 lots; spreadsheet reconciliation per family.
unit_economics_claims: Warehouse sales of $20-30k per weekend with ~30 estates
Warehouse rented for about $400 a weekend
ideas.startup_cost: Warehouse rental (his was ~$400/weekend from a relative)

uk_applicability.notes: House clearance and auction rooms exist in the UK; warehouse sales plausible with business rates and waste licensing.

risks: Item-to-buyer ratio dilution vs in-home sales
No air conditioning, lower perceived value

quotes.text: what that evolved into is a 2025,000 $30,000 weekend sale with 30 different estates
quotes.speaker: Braden

quotes.text: Warehouse sales. I think it's the best kept secret in estate sales for estate sale companies
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Estate sales as an off-market real estate deal funnel
ideas.one_liner: Use estate sale access ('first one through the front door') to buy or wholesale houses below market value.
ideas.business_model: property flips, wholesale assignment fees, rentals
ideas.customer: Estate/house owners who need a fast sale, often houses too poor to list
ideas.problem: Owners need the house and contents gone quickly
ideas.offer: Cash offer for house plus contents, quick close (two weeks), or wholesale to an end buyer

pricing.notes: Can trade a lower estate sale commission for the right to list/buy the house.

acquisition_channels.details: Asks all estate sale companies to call him about houses needing work or quick sales.

quote.text: I have never met anybody else that uses estate sale companies as a funnel for offmarket deals
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

acquisition_channels.details: Uses DealMachine to send postcards to vacant/distressed homes seen near sales.
Real estate agents send homes they can't sell.

ideas.delivery: Funded with hard-money and local lenders; flips, wholesales (including double closes) or holds as rentals.
unit_economics_claims: ~60 homes since 2018: about half wholesale, ~20 flips, rest held as short-term rentals
Bought a $70k house and relisted at $150k after pulling carpet
Six-figure income, seven-figure additional net worth
ideas.startup_cost: Little cash for wholesaling; lender funding for purchases

uk_applicability.notes: UK: assigning contracts/wholesaling is unusual; property deal sourcers must join a redress scheme, be AML-supervised by HMRC and hold client-money protections; postcards to homeowners are fine (direct mail not covered by PECR consent rules).

risks: Interest rate rises on buy-and-hold debt
Hidden defects; use inspectors and licensed contractors
Wholesale funnel must be continually refilled

quotes.text: relisted this $70,000 house for $150,000, and it was under contract in a week
quotes.speaker: Braden

quotes.text: I've wholesaliled properties for as little as 5,000 and I've wholesaliled like through a double close essentially 30,000
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Mid-term furnished rentals via Furnish Finder
ideas.one_liner: Rent furnished homes (furnished from estate finds) to travelling workers and nurses for 3+ months via Furnish Finder.
ideas.customer: Travel nurses, construction workers (e.g. at a local BIES/plant build)
ideas.problem: Workers need furnished housing for months
ideas.offer: Furnished single-family homes for 3-18 month stays
unit_economics_claims: Hosted the same workers for over a year and a half

uk_applicability.notes: UK mid-term lets exist (contractor/NHS lets via platforms like OpenRent/SpareRoom); tenancy law, licensing and Section 24 tax differ.

quotes.text: midterm rentals through Furnish Finder is definitely the bread and butter
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Yard sale flipping into an antique store booth
ideas.one_liner: Buy collectibles and vintage items at weekend yard sales and resell them from a rented antique-mall booth.
ideas.offer: Curated vintage items in a 2x10 booth

acquisition_channels.details: Antique store booth in Benton, Arkansas.

ideas.delivery: Saturday 5am mapped yard-sale runs, then stocking the booth.
unit_economics_claims: Several hundred dollars a month profit

uk_applicability.notes: UK car boot sales and antique centres work similarly.

risks: Seasonal: yard sales stop in winter

quotes.text: flipped those items for several hundred just immediately just putting them in the antique store booth in profit
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Vertically integrated life-transition company
ideas.one_liner: Handle the full move: buy contents, run the estate sale, warehouse/auction leftovers, move the client and list the house.
ideas.business_model: commissions across moving, sale and real estate listing
ideas.customer: Families in a life transition (death, divorce, move)
ideas.offer: One trusted company doing every step

pricing.model: bundle; e.g. estate sale at 25% or free if allowed to list the house

acquisition_channels.details: Trust built from estate sale work.

ideas.delivery: Company in Virginia Beach does estate sale, warehouse, auction, moving and listing.

uk_applicability.notes: UK: estate agency needs redress-scheme membership and AML registration; removals and house clearance are common.

quotes.text: there's money to be made in every single aspect, the sale of the house, the sale of the contents, the move
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Estate sale franchise
ideas.one_liner: Buy a franchise (Blue Moon, Caring Transitions, Grayson's) for $50-75k to get instant leads, training and brand.
ideas.customer: Aspiring estate sale owners with capital
ideas.offer: Turnkey brand, website and lead flow

uk_applicability.notes: Named franchises are US; UK has house-clearance franchises but different brands.

quotes.text: you can invest $50 to $75,000 to buy a franchise from Blue Moon or Caring Transitions or Grayson's
quotes.speaker: Braden

ideas.name: Done-for-you estate sale website and training (EstateSaleBiz)
ideas.one_liner: Middle option: pay $500-1,000 one-off for a website and online training with no royalties.
ideas.business_model: one-off package fee; Braden is an affiliate (10% discount code)
ideas.problem: Need a website and know-how without franchise fees

acquisition_channels.details: Braden promotes as an affiliate with a discount code.

ideas.delivery: Provider builds the website and supplies training.

uk_applicability.notes: A UK version for house clearance firms could work online.

quotes.text: you can do like a middle hybrid for 500 bucks to a thousand partnering with a company like estatesbiz.com where they do the website for you
quotes.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Work for the incumbent to learn and get overflow leads
steps: Build a relationship by shopping at the best local company's sales
Ask to work for them (offer to volunteer)
Learn staffing, pricing and paperwork
Ask them to send small leads they don't want
Become the go-to 'XYZ company' they refer

quote.text: would you consider letting me work for you for a while? And or actually I volunteered to volunteer
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Donut pitch at real estate brokerages
steps: Offer to bring breakfast/coffee/donuts to a brokerage's regular broker meeting
Get 10 minutes to explain the service
Repeat across brokerages

quote.text: nine times out of 10, those brokerages were like, "Sure."
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Room-by-room gross estimate and offer
steps: Walk the house with the client taking pictures
Walk again alone, estimating each room's gross in a notebook
If gross exceeds ~$10k and house is clean, make an offer
Quote 39% instead of 40% ('nine numbers')
Set a minimum guarantee when gross is uncertain

quote.text: We'll offer them, you know, 39% to make it sound a little sexier than 40%
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Three-day markdown structure
steps: Day 1 full price
Day 2 20-25% off
Day 3 50% off
For two-day sales: 25% off 9-noon, 50% off noon-3
Price so the day-3 50% price is still acceptable

quote.text: the first day is full price. Second day is typically 20 to 25% off if if there's any items left. And then the remaining items are 50% off on Sunday
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Bid sheet to stop haggling
steps: When a shopper asks for a discount, hand them a bid sheet
They write their offer and contact details
Call the winning bidder at end of the sale if the item remains
Use the captured contacts for a mailing list

quote.text: The remedy to that, which I love, is a bid sheet
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Lot-number cash register reconciliation
steps: Assign each estate a lot number
Write lot number on every tag
Ring up price under the lot on a multi-department register
Reconcile per lot and per payment type in a spreadsheet
Pay clients about two weeks after the sale

quote.text: The customer still pays the same price, but your your cash register separates everything out
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Capture buyer emails and sell VIP early access
steps: Collect emails and phone numbers at sales
Email upcoming sale announcements
Offer paid ($50) night-before early access

quote.text: for 50 bucks you can you can come to the night before estate sale and have first dibs
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Trade estate sale commission for the house listing/purchase
steps: Offer a lower commission (25% or free) if you can list or buy the house
Make cash offers for house plus contents when contents are too small for a sale
Ask other estate sale companies to refer houses needing work

quote.text: if you let me list the house, I can do the estate sale for instead of 35%, I can do it for 25%
quote.speaker: Braden

tactics.name: Use AI to spot valuable items for marketing
steps: Photograph everything in the house
Upload to Claude or ChatGPT and ask what is valuable or click-worthy
Feature niche/collectible items in listing descriptions to attract specific buyer personas

quote.text: today you just take pictures of everything, upload it to Claude or Chad GPT and say, I'm totally ignorant to this
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Mispricing a valuable item is every liquidator's nightmare; consult other companies or appraisers.

quote.text: Every estate liquidator's worst nightmare is putting the wrong price on an item
quote.speaker: Braden

warnings.warning: Allowing haggling once means doing it a thousand times as others overhear.

quote.text: once you do that once, if you've got a thousand people coming to your estate sale every weekend, you're going to have to do that a thousand times more
quote.speaker: Braden

warnings.warning: Bad pictures, low-quality items or weather can drop attendance to 30-50 people a day.
Interest rate rises blindsided his buy-and-hold real estate.

quote.text: one thing that blindsided me was on the on the buy and holds is the interest rates
quote.speaker: Braden

warnings.warning: Going full throttle into real estate and leaving estate sales was a mistake in hindsight.

quote.text: I kind of went full throttle into real estate investment, which in hindsight was a mistake
quote.speaker: Braden

warnings.warning: Don't promise clients a line-by-line list of sold items; only for high-value items.
Guns, drugs, cash and IDs turn up in houses; regulations vary (UK firearms law is strict; extractor note).
Wholesaling requires constantly refilling the deal funnel.

quote.text: I have got to keep this funnel up forever if I'm gonna, you know, maintain income. Wholesaling is tough
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: Life transitions (death, divorce, moves) are when people spend money; build offers around them.

quote.text: when you move, when there's a change in your in your life, that is when you spend money
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: A service paid out of gross sales collected by you gives positive cash conversion and needs no capital.

quote.text: that's a positive cash flow conversion cycle and it it enables this business to be one of the few ones that technically don't require any money
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Competitors are often happy to refer overflow; become their trusted alternative.

quote.text: they love having an alternative. and they can say I can't do it but XYZ company can and we became their XYZ company
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: Surface area: each unique item is a separate marketing angle that pulls in a different buyer persona.

quote.text: I love the principle of surface area
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: A low-margin service can be a front-door lead source for a far more profitable business.

quote.text: You're the first one through the front door
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: Price like occupancy: selling 95%+ on day one means you underpriced.
Items sell for more in context (staged in a nice home) than in a warehouse.

quote.text: I'm almost certain that that items that are offered in a house sell better and for higher pricing than than what you would sell it for in the warehouse
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: Analog, unsexy, hard businesses stay uncrowded because most people take the path of least resistance.

quote.text: because it's ugly and it's hard and it's sweaty and it's difficult and it's unscalable and it's not AI and everyone's chasing AI
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Test the market before spending on renovation; listing as-is can work.

quote.text: Why don't you just list it for a month and just see what happens
quote.speaker: Braden

lessons.lesson: Low-commitment businesses let you quit cheaply compared to leases and restaurants.
